title: The desert has a voice
product_promise: Hear real booming sand and see the conditions behind the surprise.

style_reference.inherited_system: Immediate meaningful frame; stable phrase subtitles; purposeful deterministic motion; source labels; finished sound tail.
style_reference.rejected_legacy_pattern: Text-led ledger rows and generic repeated slideshow layouts.
style_reference.deliberate_deviation: User approved pilot voice, motion, pacing, and requested scientific continuation before language polish. Original opening and ending preserved.
